item.text:
Refactor complete.

- `Field` now stores `Animal[][]` and `Plant[][]` instead of `Object[][]`, with typed APIs like `getAnimalAt`, `placeAnimal`, and `clearAnimal` in [`Field.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Field.java).
- Callers now use the typed field API, removing casts and `instanceof` checks in [`Animal.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Animal.java), [`CarnivoreAnimal.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/CarnivoreAnimal.java), [`Plant.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Plant.java), [`FieldStats.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/FieldStats.java), and [`SimulatorView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/SimulatorView.java).
- I also tightened the collection types to `Class<?>`/`Map<Class<?>, ...>` in the stats and UI layers, and made the core grids/registries immutable where appropriate.
- [`Dashboard.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R006_module_java/Dashboard.java) was updated to match the generic counter type as well.

Verification:
- Compiled the updated core classes successfully with `javac`.
- The JavaFX UI sources still aren’t directly buildable in this environment, so I verified them through temporary stubs rather than a full desktop build.

If you want, the next highest-value cleanup is probably:
1. Simplify `Simulator` orchestration and remove a bit more shared mutable state.
2. Refactor `Dashboard.java` to remove the duplicated chart-building/update code.
3. Split `Field`’s block/statistics logic into a dedicated analyzer class.
